description: Test suite for language hints filtering and normalization functions related to diff viewer payloads in a codebase.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters input language hints, retaining only supported ones and replacing unsupported ones with 'text'.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes language hints in the diff viewer payload, converting invalid or blank hints to 'text' and preserving valid ones.
